target_firewall.note: The target firewall remains intact. The integrity ruling is based on source receipts and frozen admission law, not HSI outcomes.

integrity_ruling.reason: Source-only audit found omitted Russia/Ukraine and Iraq operational events plus an unswept official UKMTO incident stream. UKMTO warnings 144-146 predate the later Reuters/Marisks aggregate used for the original Oct-1 Hormuz admission.

qualifying_late_rows.note: Retained source-only in late-recovery receipt; never measured or used for clean credit.

audited_exclusions.headline: Russian drones kill people around Kyiv and other regions
audited_exclusions.reason: Reuters describes continued intensive attacks in an already-active barrage. The frozen law requires a material change in the risk channel; the next day's unusually persistent jet-drone escalation is separately admitted.

audited_exclusions.headline: Russia says it struck military infrastructure and vessels in Ukraine
audited_exclusions.reason: Operational continuation of the same active strike campaign; no separately identified material policy/risk-channel change.

audited_exclusions.headline: Taiwan transfers senior naval commander to Coast Guard to boost deterrence coordination
audited_exclusions.reason: Official personnel/coordination change, but bounded source review did not establish a material change in the active cross-strait risk channel under the frozen admission rule.

audited_exclusions.headline: Middle East oil exports rise while tanker attacks increase
audited_exclusions.reason: Retrospective shipping/flow synthesis describing already-recorded tanker risk, not a new first-disclosure geopolitical event.

bounded_source_audit.note: The earlier two-row miss estimate is superseded. A date-by-date audit found a systemic Reuters-only recall gap for maritime security. Oct 6 remains open and uncertified.

parent_cluster_dependence.purpose: Dependence disclosure only; Epoch 1 is quarantined before target read.
parent_cluster_dependence.note: Do not translate family/cluster count into an effective sample size. Epoch 1 receives no pooled target review.

future_accrual_safeguard.operational_rule: Clean target validation restarts in a new source-first epoch. For each UTC source day, freeze a completed source-only census/disposition receipt across declared family-specific channels before opening any event's U.S. leg. Physical shipping-security requires UKMTO plus Reuters/wire. Unresolved source clocks remain logged but unmeasured.
future_accrual_safeguard.late_recovery_rule: Any qualifying source row discovered only after relevant U.S. exposure quarantines that row; a recurrent systematic recall failure quarantines the epoch. Never backfill to rescue sample size.

initial_row_integrity_corrections.evidence: UKMTO warnings 144-26, 145-26 and 146-26 were publicly issued on 2026-09-30 for three separate tanker attacks that occurred on 2026-09-29. The later Reuters/Marisks row aggregated those separate incidents and therefore is not the earliest exact decision-eligible source representation.
initial_row_integrity_corrections.repair: Do not retime or split this already-exposed row into evaluable observations. Preserve the immutable receipt and recover the official maritime incidents only as late/non-evaluable source evidence.

source_recall_root_cause.detail: The first bounded census relied heavily on Reuters/wire retrieval and did not systematically sweep UKMTO, the official maritime-security warning owner. This caused separate Hormuz incidents to be omitted or aggregated under a later secondary clock.
source_channels_added_for_future_admissi: UKMTO warnings/advisories for physical shipping-security family

epoch2_activation.clean_credit_rule: earliest decision-eligible public available_at must be strictly after activation commit time and pass the completed-source-day admission gate before any U.S. measurement
